comparison.objective: Crank a hose reel while guiding adjacent hose turns; candidate iteratively tunes and locks a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Continuous bimanual reel rotation and deformable-hose laying versus rigid collar adjustment, recessed-key use, bounded tightening, and cycle testing.
comparison.success_condition: Neatly wound hose versus repeatable non-bottoming carriage stops with measured post-lock stability.
comparison.reason: Shared rotation and bimanual coordination are generic; the mechanisms and outcomes are materially different. No spec versions or numeric neatness criteria were available.
